records.description: A XclusivSX foi criada porque percebemos que muitas plataformas de conteúdo adulto estão cheias de anúncios invasivos, redirecionamentos e interrupções que prejudicam a experiência do usuário.Nosso objetivo é oferecer uma alternativa mais limpa, organizada e focada na qualidade. Na XclusivSX, os anúncios são moderados e não interrompem a reprodução dos vídeos.

records.name: WatchDecider
records.tagline: Stop scrolling. Start watching. Discover movies with a swipe
records.description: Decide what to watch in under 10 seconds. Smart movie, TV show, and anime recommendations tailored to your mood for free. Simply swipe right on titles you like and left on ones you don't. Your liked picks are saved for later, while disliked titles won't appear again, helping you cut through endless scrolling and discover content that matches your taste for free.

records.name: SpendOS
records.tagline: SpendOS — Intelligence behind every decision.
records.description: SpendOS is an AI-powered spend intelligence platform built to help teams gain real-time visibility into spending patterns, identify inefficiencies, and make smarter financial decisions. Unlike traditional expense tools focused only on tracking, SpendOS turns spend data into actionable insights with intelligent analytics, forecasting, and optimization recommendations helping businesses reduce waste and drive growth with confidence.

records.name: TMLink
records.tagline: Unlock the Power of Connected Data
records.description: In today's data-driven world, organizations face a significant challenge: data fragmentation. With information scattered across multiple sources, systems, and formats, it's difficult to get a complete and accurate view of the data. TMLink helps overcome this challenge by connecting the dots — enabling businesses and institutions to uncover new insights, improve decision-making, and drive innovation.

The research caliber the world's largest institutions have relied on for a century, now in minutes instead of days.
